title: Midaz transaction committed
description: A ledger transaction whose movement was applied and recorded with status APPROVED, as published by the midaz producer.

action.description: The ledger transition that reached APPROVED: a direct create, the commit of a pending transaction, or a revert of an approved one.

direction.description: Classified by the side of each leg (its debit or credit direction, not its type), fee legs ignored: INFLOW when every source leg is the external counterparty and no destination leg is, OUTFLOW when every destination leg is and no source leg is, INTERNAL when no leg is, MIXED otherwise.

amount.description: The amount the sender authorized: a plain decimal string, trailing zeros trimmed, never a float; fee legs are listed in operations with feeLeg true.

scheme.description: The rail or classification the movement was declared under, normalized upper-case.

parentTransactionId.description: The transaction this one reverts; present only when action is revert.

groupId.description: The cross-ledger group this transaction is one part of.

createdAt.description: The transaction's effective date as stored in created_at (transactionDate when the client supplied one), RFC 3339.

operations.description: The legs the completion recorded for the transaction.

amount.description: The amount the leg moved: a plain decimal string, trailing zeros trimmed, never a float.

accountId.description: The ledger account the leg moved; an opaque system identifier.

external.description: True when the leg's account is the @external/<asset> counterparty of the ledger.

feeLeg.description: True when the fee engine added the leg; the net of a destination is derivable from the legs without it.
